data.name: The Graveyard Shift with Kopper
data.description: The Wayback Machine has been laid to rest as Kopper takes to the Graveyard Shift, digging up new, dangerous underground sounds—unfiltered punk and punk-adjacent rock, lo-fi noise, garage/psych, and electronic weirdness unearthed from below the surface.

data.name: Positively Everything with Moe Fuz
data.description: Moe Fuz brings you "Positively Everything" he loves: local artists, upcoming concerts, new releases, personal classics, and "Fuz's finds" of folk, funk and punk, country, comedy and crooners...all gleaned from the finest thrift stores in the land.

data.name: Sovereign Glory with Randall Roberts
data.description: Sovereign Glory is a mix of old and new organized noise that revels at the intersection of out-there jazz, experimental electronic music, ambient, strange rock, contemporary classical and archival found sound.

data.name: Rebroadcast of Musical Merry Go-Round with Grandfather Stark
data.description: Jump on the Musical Merry-Go-Round with Grandfather Paul Stark as he shares an hour of family friendly music, stories and guests. You'll hear music from all genres and time periods, suitable for anyone of any age. (Sunday mornings feature a rebroadcast of the Saturday morning show.)

data.name: Family Reunion with Judy Stein
data.description: Family Reunion will be mainly playing folk songs and their relation to one another: their ancestry, journeys from one part of the world to another, common themes, influence on later music. Reuniting the family, so to speak.

data.name: Songwriters Showcase with Steve St. Cyr
data.description: Songwriters Showcase features some of the best music that falls between mainstream folk and Americana. The mix ranges from intimate singer-songwriter tracks to gritty alt-country, spotlighting artists coming to our area soon.

data.name: The Snappy Lunch with Walter & Willa
data.description: The Snappy Lunch will follow the footsteps of Bluegrass Breakdown for nearly 25 years. Mostly traditional style bluegrass, new and old, and maybe a country or an Americana tune thrown in. Bluegrass music news, events and occasional interviews.

data.name: No Time to Tarry Here with Pablo Meshugi
data.description: Traditional folk music and related stuff, including both source musicians and musicians from the Folk Revival. Your host Pablo Meshugi draws from musicians from America, the British Isles, Europe, Africa and the rest of the world, and there is a segment each week devoted to music from 78 r.p.m. records.

data.name: Folks of the World with Harriet Shanas
data.description: Join us travelers as we crisscross the globe listening to and learning about music from countries and cultures all over the world. Sounds that strike a familiar chord as well as those you’ve never heard before … folk, traditional and contemporary. There’s something for everyone on Folks of the World.

data.name: Chicken Shack with Bruce B. & Tony C.
data.description: Bruce B. with deep blues, classic soul and hot R&B, alternating with Tony C and a mix of blues, soul, R&B, jazz and doo-wop. Tune in every Sunday evening for blues you can only get at the "Chicken Shack."

data.name: Nothin' But the Blues with Ron Edwards & Matthew Heiple
data.description: Ron Edwards and Matt Heiple alternate weekly themes featuring the rich tapestry of Blues music history and culture, showcasing classic to contemporary tracks.

data.name: R.S.V.P. with Your Lady Edie B
data.description: A crystal‑clear blend of straight‑ahead jazz and tender vocals — delivered in the quiet hours when the music gets personal.

data.name: 3 Minutes & a Cloud of Vinyl with Matthew Heiple
data.description: Join Matty for an all vinyl hour, featuring Mama Matty's collection of late 50s-early 70s 45s, as well as cuts from both of our 33s. Embrace the glorious crackles, hisses & pops of vinyl!

data.name: In the Middle of the Night with Kevin Lawrence
data.description: Kevin Lawrence is the late night voice for jazz loving insomniacs. Spinning the jazz classics from Birdland to dreamland.

data.name: World of Wonder with Kate Ryan
data.description: Join Kate as she whirls up a global blend of Folk, Pop, Jazz and Psychedelic and Electronic sounds especially for you in the Wee Hours or any hours. All are welcome in this World of Wonder!

data.name: Fresh Start with Atomic Ace
data.description: Whether you’re already on your way or just getting up, allow Ace to spice up your sunrise with syncopated rhythms and interesting instrumentation. Discover new favorites while dancing into the week.

data.name: Backroads with Stacy
data.description: A mix of folk, singer-songwriter, Americana and acoustic music, all found along the back roads.

data.name: Herencia Latina with Lydia G
data.description: Join Lydia G as she spins, melds and explores the dynamic diversity and beauty of the Latin musical lineage in the US and around the world in Spanish and English.

data.name: Music at Work with Curt
data.description: Curt is the boss of Music at Work, a full sonic employment of rock and Americana, with featured artists, new releases, concert news and more.

data.name: Monday Mix with Matty Dread
data.description: Monday Mix with Matty Dread

data.name: Bittersweet Melody with Allen
data.description: Join your navigator Allen as he guides you from Abbey Road to Fascination Street, Freeze Outs on 10th Avenue, or maybe just a Road to Nowhere. It's a wide mix of rock, Americana, power pop, alternative country and more.

data.name: Mystery Train with Tim Rakel
data.description: Hop aboard Mystery Train, with host Tim Rakel, a musical journey connecting global rock, weird country, and strange folk with occasional branches into metal, punk and blues.

data.name: Serious Journalism with Bass Amp
data.description: You know those French films that explore existential crises? Yeah, it’s nothing like that… Serious Journalism is a weirdo-rock adventure hosted by Bass Amp... it’s a new kinda Cult!

data.name: Universal Default with Brian Lock
data.description: All hail the drone! Brian scans the universe for psychedelia and experimental sounds to knock your world off its axis.

data.name: The Kitchen Sink with B Mack
data.description: The Kitchen Sink with B Mack

data.name: Sound (N)Decisions with Landy Dandy
data.description: A free-form eclectic mix exploring different sounds, tempos, eras, genres, who can decide really? No style is off limits: funk, soul, jazz, indie, rock, hip-hop, R&B, etc. If it sounds good, it's getting played.

data.name: Hip City with Chris Lawyer
data.description: Head across the tracks to Hip City, where soul, funk, R&B and hip hop all blissfully coexist, and no one discriminates against dance music, no matter the genre. The desired effect is what you get with Chris, every Tuesday morning.

data.name: Hey Hey My My with Darren Snow
data.description: Hey hey, my my! Rock and roll is very much alive as Darren Snow brings you the latest releases from the worlds of indie rock, garage rock, synth-pop, and whatever else sounds good--plus some old favorites from the last seven decades of pop, rock, soul, and more.

data.name: Latin Hemispheres with Carlos G. Charles
data.description: Providing a wide spectrum of alternative Latin music, Carlos G. Charles brings you a mix of traditional rhythms incorporating modern hybrid beats: rock, folk, blues, hip hop, jazz & all points in between. It's a two-hour musical journey. It’s Latin Hemispheres.

data.name: The Bridge with DJ Whiz
data.description: The Bridge is 2 hours of good vibes and great grooves with your host DJ Whiz and plenty of guest hosts adding their beams to the bridge. With jazz and hip hop as the foundation, The Bridge explores the DNA of music, new and old; showcasing those connections between the songs you know and love throughout time and sound!

data.name: Grooves United with Isis Ain
data.description:
An Eclectic Mix of Genres:
Rock, Reggae, and Global.

data.name: Hindsight with Matt
data.description: Hindsight is an Indie/Alternative rock program featuring sounds from the underground. Spanning over the past half century through present day, from Post-punk synthesizers, to chiming, shimmering Indiepop guitars to ethereal, Shoegaze soundscapes.

data.name: Open the Door, Richard with Rich Mueller
data.description: Primarily rock music that won't be found on any commercial radio station, with a mix of other genres including Jazz, Funk, Soul and even Country. Anything is possible!

data.name: Train of Thought with Nick Cowan
data.description: Train Of Thought is going to rock. DJ Nick Cowan will play all the things that rock means, but expect that train to derail into all of the music out there. Expect forays to hip hop, folk, jazz, songwriters, death metal, and all of it. When the show is over, it will flow like your new favorite mix tape.

data.name: The Crooked Spire with Mark Longden
data.description: Ambient, drone, sound art, kosmische...all the quiet music. Lull yourself back to sleep, quiet a crying baby, or accompany your late night study session with The Crooked Spire.

data.name: The Smoking Lounge with Brother Dan
data.description: Join Brother Dan for a journey through Genre bending progressive rock, eclectic fusion and a heavy dose of Frank Zappa. It's the Smoking Lounge 2.0.

data.name: Essence of the Tribes with KiowaKat
data.description: Essence of the Tribes with KiowaKat brings you the music created and performed by American Indian Tribal citizens. From the traditional to the contemporary, Essence of the Tribes features American Indian music, connecting it to the news, culture, and history that is going on in Indian country today.

data.name: Feel Like Going Home with Roy Kasten
data.description: Prodigal songs, wayward grooves, lyrical detours, soul folk in action -- that's Feel Like Going Home, with Roy Kasten, three hours of indie rock, errant twang, dusty blues and acoustic-electric ballads to ease you into Wednesday morning.

data.name: Shady Grove with Keith Dudding
data.description: If you love bluegrass and old-time music -- from Bill Monroe to Billy Strings, from Dock Boggs to Doc Watson, from Uncle Dave Macon to Uncle Earl -- then you're bound for Shady Grove. It's the sound of fiddle tunes, banjo breakdowns, and high lonesome harmonies on Shady Grove with Keith Dudding.

data.name: Daily City Train with BaqBeet
data.description: Join DJ BaqBeet as he drives the Daily City Train through the past, present, and future of electronic, hip hop, rock, funk, and more.

data.name: Uncontrollable Urge with bobEE Sweet
data.description: Get an Uncontrollable Urge with bobEE Sweet. From the music your grandparents love to the music your parents hate, from iconoclasts to copycats, from old time to new wave, we'll liberate Wednesday afternoons with sound. There will be occasional specials on a variety of themes and events.

data.name: Howzit Bayou? with Sunny Boy Mason
data.description: All the good things from down the Mississippi-- Trad Jazz, New Orleans R&B and Rock&Roll, Cajun, Zydeco, Tex-Mex, Calypso, Ska, and a lot of related sounds, including a bunch of St. Louis Roots music.

data.name: Juxtaposition with Rob Levy
data.description: From intimate English-garden pop to next month's dance-floor sensations, Rob Levy's bag of transoceanic treats is comfortably crowded with nice things you'll like.

data.name: The Space Parlour with Nick Acquisto
data.description: An eccentric variety-show of melodic art-pop, psychedelia, punk, zolo, new wave, folk, electronic, jazz, fuzz, showtunes & other inventive alternative sounds with a focus on new releases, STL music and artists playing in town...Parlour music, space music and such.

data.name: Roll Initiative with DJ Spectre
data.description: Whether you're fighting monsters or on the way into the office, tune in for an electric mix of power metal, symphonic metal, old school heavy metal, and everything in between.

data.name: The Rack with Tom Franken
data.description: The Rack is an experimental hodgepodge. Two hours of avant-garde music stitched together with soundscapes and samples. It's artificial, pretentious, and just plain fun. Put on your headphones (where applicable).

data.name: Out on the Floor with DJ Mod Myke
data.description: Northern Soul focused, with R&B, garage rock, funk, crossover, and early reggae, all hand-picked to get you out on the floor. Every week DJ Mod Myke digs through his collection of 45's to bring you two hours of 1960's-era dance music, all on vinyl. Expect deep cuts, obscure tracks, and plenty of upbeat Rare Soul.

data.name: The Mix-Up with Kristin
data.description: It’s a groove-driven show, soul, funk, indie, jazz, and roots - mixed by feel, not genre. Old and new sit together if they move the room.

data.name: Memphis to Manchester with John Wendland
data.description: A fun-filled and action-packed three hours of soul, R&B, roots, rock, folk, and beyond. Upbeat some of the time, boring none of the time.

data.name: Pop! The Beat Bubble Burst with Rich Reese
data.description: The show that explores the music of the sixties with an emphasis on British Invasion and Mersey Beat, tracing those branches up to the present day using examples from different decades.

data.name: The Now Sound with Dr. Jeff
data.description: Hi-Fi for your Wi-Fi! A shiny, new, two-hour updated version of that old show you used to know and love/like/tolerate. Freeform radio in its purest form. Whether it’s 60 minutes old or 60 years old, great music is great music -- and you'll hear it all on the Now Sound with Dr. Jeff.

data.name: Life of Surprises with Doug Morgan
data.description: An unscripted freeform freestyle fusion of soul, jazz, funk, hip-hop, and all other groovy genres in between. No rules, no boundaries.

data.name: Confluence Blues with East Side Slim
data.description: Just like a river, the Blues flows through all American music. And as the waters of the Missouri, Illinois, and Mississippi Rivers form a greater body at St Louis, Confluence Blues rides the flow of blues, soul, rock 'n' roll... jazz, swing, and everything... into the eddies of your soul.

data.name: Local Harvest with Jon Valley
data.description: Local Harvest is a deep exploration of the local music scene and the local musicians creating the art that we all get to enjoy in our music libraries and at the live venues around town. The show includes all genres, and the blurring of the lines between them. All local, all genre, that's Local Harvest. And all local musicians are invited to send their music in. It's the closest thing to open mic radio you'll find.

data.name: Heaven's Library with Max
data.description: A secular show of transcendent tunes. A mix of jazz, international folk, dreamy grooves, ambient sounds, and of course, Italian Library music. Heaven’s Library is everything angelic and ethereal. Easy but profound listening. Life is hard; these tunes feel like a warm hug.

data.name: Get Around Sound with Nick Avel
data.description: Enjoy live mixes of rock, rare groove, world beat and more as Nick drops the needle on unexpected treasures from all regions and decades of recorded music. Take the journey the last hour of every Thursday and the first hour of every Friday on CRSTL.FM

data.name: Next Exit with X24
data.description: There is another dimension, beyond that which is known to commercial radio. It is a dimension as vast as space and as timeless as infinity. It is the middle ground between light and shadow, between sound and vision. This is the dimension of freeform imagination - rock, reggae, avant-garde, soul, jazz, country, hiphop, punk, world, classical - together. You cannot make out what is coming towards you. Up ahead, it’s NEXT EXIT …

data.name: Dissolving Clouds with Dee
data.description: Dissolving Clouds brings clarity and productivity to your day, featuring sounds and styles -- post-rock, folk, ambient, indie, and experimental -- to help you find and maintain your focus. Your mind may wander, but that's O.K. Join your host Dee for two hours of music that dissolves the distractions that cloud the mind.

data.name: Downtime with Sean
data.description: Relaxed moods, cozy atmospheres. Think of the artwork on the Celestial Seasonings Sleepytime tea box, and that's basically what we're going for here. This show is what that bear on there is hearing inside his mind.

data.name: Move On Up with Jim Bruce
data.description: Soul, Funk, Rock, and Blues. Jim Bruce brings you these styles and more in a mix that comes straight from the Gut.

data.name: Sweet Inspiration with Spencer
data.description: Spencer creates a musical family tree to pull from and try to connect the dots through various genres. Mainly pop, Rock, Soul, Country, and Jazz from the last 75 years.

data.name: Beyon' Cray with Crim
data.description: Beyon' Cray gives you music to move to. Crim spins an eclectic, electric vinyl collection of late '60s and '70s disco, funk, rock and soul. Sounds include everything from slow jams on rollerskates to uptempo party boogie. It's music to make you dance, only here on Community Radio STL.

data.name: Dangerous Curves with Sherri Danger
data.description: Add a woman to radio, and you've got "Dangerous Curves". Join host Sherri Danger as she presents her unique female perspective on music - just remember to wear your seat belts. It's Dangerous Curves, and she's driving, every Friday afternoon.

data.name: Blues In the Night with Art Dwyer
data.description: Art Dwyer brings you blues, R&B, jazz and soul for your soul - "None of the hits, all of the time". Since 1987.

data.name: Ital Rhythms with Ital-K
data.description: A diversified Reggae program loaded with Inspirational Messages, served over a bed of versatile and charismatic rhythms. A Finger-Licking, Foot-Tapping, Head-Nodding, Body-Moving experience that takes a full 2 hours to enjoy.

data.name: Acid Stew with Andy J
data.description: Marinate your brain in an unpredictable but satisfying and trippy blend with Andy J - from fresh local releases to classic music that soundtracks the River City's underground. If it's good, it will be added to the pot!

data.name: Scene of the Crime with Jason Rerun
data.description: Jason Rerun spins the least famous to the most obscure Punk, New Wave, Power Pop and underground music from the '70s-'90s.

data.name: Floored with Michael James
data.description: A marriage of gothic rock, industrial dance, metal, and electronica with an emphasis on female singers. Floored will also feature local artists!

data.name: Musical Merry-Go-Round with Grandfather Stark
data.description: Jump on the Musical Merry-Go-Round with Grandfather Paul Stark as he shares an hour of family friendly music, stories and guests. You'll hear music from all genres and time periods, suitable for anyone of any age.

data.name: Move the Needle with Steve Leftridge
data.description: Every Saturday morning, the Midnight Backslider curates musical milestones, historic and current events, classic and contemporary artists, and local potpourri into an aural cornucopia of timely, connected, genre-fluid, musical mellifluousness.

data.name: Full Circle with DJ Jackie T.
data.description: From classic cuts to modern sounds, Full Circle connects music across time spanning from blues, soul, and rock and roll, to country, folk, and Americana. Great sound always comes back around.

data.name: The Midday Jamboree with Fred Gumaer
data.description: The Midday Jamboree with Fred Gumaer brings you the history of country music including early string bands, bluegrass, western swing, honky tonk and rockabilly styles, as well as contemporary, roots-oriented country artists.

data.name: The Back Country with Jeff Corbin
data.description: Ride The Back Country with Jeff Corbin for country recordings spanning more than 100 years. Birthdays, folks coming to town, local and regional artists, and new releases. Check out The Back Country only here at Community Radio St. Louis.

data.name: Wax Lyrical with Caron
data.description: Music that celebrates the singer-songwriter craft, with old favorites and new discoveries, focusing on folk and Americana.

data.name: NoMo FOMO with Courtney
data.description: From sweaty basement clubs to plush theater seats, there’s never a dull moment in the St. Louis music scene. NOMO FOMO is here to make sure you don’t miss out.

data.name: Deep Krate Radio with DJ Furious Iceman Stylz
data.description: New underground Hip-Hop and classic old school jams mixed live and direct on two turntables every Friday night.

data.name: Positive Vibrations with Professor Skank
data.description: Join Professor Skank or Matty Dread as they switch off each week to bring you 2 hours of the greatest Reggae music on the planet.

data.name: Elevated Rhymestate with Wil Wander
data.description: Elevated Rhymestate explores and celebrates the evolution of hip-hop as it has built from and given back to the greater world of music. Focusing on active, melodic production complemented by flowing, poetic lyrics, each show is a curated demonstration of the depth of musicality within the ever-expanding breadth of the genre. From the local to the global, your next great hip-hop discovery is on Elevated Rhymestate.
